tables.name: Resident Attitude
tables.description: How the current residents feel about daily life in the fortress.

results.name: Angry
results.description: The residents hate being here. Not a day goes by where they don’t actively think about leaving, but they have stayed for some reason, perhaps one outside their control.

results.name: Irritated
results.description: The residents are perturbed by this place. Something about it, or their situation, is irksome and grates on them daily.

results.name: Ambivalent
results.description: The residents could take or leave this place. They have other things on their minds, and do not devote much thought to the fortress.

results.name: Content
results.description: The residents like the fortress well enough. The place itself, or their circumstances, may not be ideal, but things aren’t so bad.

results.name: Happy
results.description: The residents like the fortress, or are pleased with their situation (or both). Things are good and spirits are up.

results.name: Enthused
results.description: The residents are thrilled to be here. The fortress, or their circumstances (or both) are wonderfully suited to them, and convincing them to leave would be extremely difficult.
